body:
## Summary

Two workspace-confinement breaks:

### 1. `loadLocalSkill` path traversal (src/bos/infrastructure/remote_skills.ts:182-197)

`loadLocalSkill(name)` does `path.join(dir, name)` with **no validation** — the `VALID_SEG`/`..` segment checks exist only in `loadRemoteSkill` (remote_skills.ts:470-475). `load_offline_skill` is also absent from `TOOL_FILE_PARAMS` (src/bos/infrastructure/config/workspaceGuard.ts:107-119), so `wrapAllTools` doesn't guard it either.

Model-controlled input reaches it via the `load_offline_skill` tool: `name = "../../../../Users/victim/notes"` reads `/Users/victim/notes.md`, or `name = "../../x/SKILL.md"` reads any `SKILL.md` on disk. Verified: the validation code exists only in the remote path; the local path joins unvalidated.

**Fix:** validate segments in `loadLocalSkill` before `path.join` (reject `.`/`..`, enforce `VALID_SEG`), mirroring `loadRemoteSkill`, and/or add `load_offline_skill` to `TOOL_FILE_PARAMS`.

### 2. `papers_download` bypasses the workspace guard for `outputDir` (src/bos/infrastructure/http/papers_tools.ts:23-29)

```ts
const guard = resolveInWorkspace(outputDir.trim(), wsRoot);
if (guard.ok) { primary = guard.resolved; } else { primary = outputDir.trim(); }
```
When `resolveInWorkspace` **fails** (path outside the workspace), the raw user path is used anyway — `ensureWritable` then creates it and the download writes there. The guard's purpose (confine writes to the workspace) is defeated. Contrast `papers_list_downloaded`, which returns `err(guard.error)` for the same failure.

**Fix:** `else { return err(guard.error); }` for parity.
title: SECURITY: loadLocalSkill path traversal reads arbitrary files; papers_download bypasses workspace guard on failed resolution
